notes: Broad searches were capped at the first 100 returned records; targeted title/abstract searches were added to recover directly relevant older literature.
The union is a discovery pool, not a fully adjudicated exclusion set. Not all returned records received abstract review.
No full abstracts or article PDFs are redistributed. Search results change over time.
English scientific indexing predominates. French-language historical and community-led sources require separate searches.
Traditional-use provenance is Canadian; experiments may be from any country. No new settler ethnobotanical paper was verified in this batch.
retrieval_count_scope: unique_retrieved_records describes the original discovery union only; supplemental search overlap was not recomputed
